_instructions: Marker sizes pop=1 and pop=2 choose the closest reviewed physical venue. Sizes 3 and 4, Wikipedia/memorial pins and local pins require a venue within one international mile (1.609344 km). Do not confuse pop (size) with tier (appearance zoom).

When no physical offer lies within one mile, identified international airports may show a Japan eSIM, JR stations a nationwide JR pass, and Tokyo Metro/Toei subway stations a Tokyo Subway ticket. Never assign fake coordinates to these products. Unverified operators receive no rail fallback.
All 47 prefectures retain region-search fallback for the largest two sizes only when no reviewed product or relevant travel fallback can be selected. Other sizes never fall back to distant regions.
This is a partial manually verified catalog, not all Klook Japan inventory. Official API/feed availability was not confirmed. The owner declined contacting support; do not send an inquiry.
Public affiliate ID 134890 is verified for JAPAN TIME ATLAS. Link format: https://affiliate.klook.com/custom_tag_guide; k_site is last. No secrets or visitor/click identifiers belong here.

Physical products require verified venue coordinates. Recheck all offers within 180 days; expired reviews are suppressed. Prices, dates, eligibility, exchange locations and available services remain on Klook.
Klook landing pages returned a redirect error with attribution in the setup browser. Do not claim booking attribution or payouts are verified; see KLOOK-MAINTENANCE.md.
